name: Monopoly Melts Live Rosin Disposable | Tally Mon
description:
Lineage: Sunset Sherb x Grape Pie

This cut has major sherb terps with just the right touch of fruit. Heavy on the body, light on tht mind - this strain is one of our team’s go to’s for many reasons. Come find out what the hype is about.
